fixes.find: gazed at the child, never still for an instant, lovely like a little bird.
fixes.reason: Japanese gives never-still and bird-like loveliness to the child, not to the mother's eyes.
fixes.replace: gazed at the child, who was never still for an instant, lovely like a little bird.

fixes.find: she was quietly remembering the quiet tear-filled days,
fixes.reason: Japanese has one quietly for the remembering, with no quiet on the days themselves.
fixes.replace: she was quietly remembering the tear-filled days,

fixes.find: "A storm," the man whispered, standing still.
fixes.reason: Japanese ends with na, a quiet assent that closes the storm heard forgotten heard arc.
fixes.replace: "A storm, isn't it," the man whispered, standing still.

data.say: Final read leaves supper and vision intact and proposes three local wording fixes.
data.verdict: Ready after the fixes below: voice and crux hold throughout, with only local wording to correct.
